text.title: Freelancer Payment Chase Script Library Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping the invoice's observable state (days overdue, payment status, dispute status, rungs already sent) to the rule from 01-core-rules.xml that governs the next action.

decision-tree.root-question: Is the invoice past its due date, with invoice number, amount, due date and the contract payment-terms clause pinned to the source of record?

conclusion.verdict: do not send anything; fetch the invoice and contract from the system of record first; a chase without the facts is worse than silence.

branch.question: Has the client paid in full, paid partially, or raised a written dispute since the last rung?

conclusion.verdict: halt the ladder; log the outcome; route a dispute to dispute handling, not to the next rung.
recompute the outstanding balance and restate it on every later rung before continuing the ladder.

branch.when: paid_in_full == false AND dispute_raised == false AND partial_payment == false
branch.question: Which rung does the clock and the send log call for?

conclusion.verdict: no send yet; wait for T+3.

branch.when: days_overdue >= 3 AND days_overdue < 10 AND polite_sent == false

conclusion.verdict: send the polite rung: invoice attached, one question, under 120 words, no consequences; log the send.

branch.when: days_overdue >= 10 AND days_overdue < 30 AND firm_sent == false

conclusion.verdict: send the firm rung: pay-by date within 7 days, one contract-backed consequence, finance contact added; log the send.
send the formal notice: ledger with interest per clause or statute, 7 to 14 day final deadline, named next step, via email and the contract's written-notice channel; log the send.
ladder exhausted; hand off to the named legal or collections contact with the full send log; record days-to-pay for renewal.
block the draft; remove or source every fee, interest rate or suspension claim before sending.

text.example: Invoice 2026-041, due 2026-06-15, facts pinned → day 3, no payment, no dispute → polite rung sent 2026-06-18 and logged → client pays 2026-06-20 → paid_in_full → halt, log days-to-pay = 5.
